machine.name: a3-9362-8die-tp8
machine.note: one A3 host (192.168.13.165), 4 two-die packages = 8 dies 8-15, one rank per die; links are omitted so the machine's declared transfer channels materialize four SIO intra-package pairs at 448 GB/s and one 8-die HCCS_SW intra-node link at 196 GB/s; fixpipe (L0C->GM) write bandwidth declared for the V4 quant lightning indexer: 3.70 TB/s, identified from the hp-serving/v4f-a3-prefill c1 torch_npu trace (raw effective 3.68 TB/s at q4096; 3.678-4.011 TB/s (q8192 chunks steady ~4.00, q4096 3.68; the earlier 7.17/6.66/6.15 numbers were an arithmetic error and are retracted)); identified domain: one s2 block per s1 group, int8 index kernel, A3/arch32. A fused-op fixpipe use outside that domain must report unknown capacity, never reuse this number. Not declared for A5/arch35.

source: retained serving recipe+44 attention calls; target dimensions conditional

The analytic compressed-row model prices 6.35 KB/token (3.28M tokens); the two capacity statements are not comparable and the analytic number is never substituted for the engine's line.
metadata.row_policy: measured rows are declared by the cells manifest; a row is applied only for its exact hardware/geometry. The A3 attention rows are Qwen2.5 GQA, the grouped int8 rows are 12/16/256 local experts, and the communication rows are 2/4-rank; none matches this TP8 32-local-expert MLA/DSA geometry, so those paths stay analytic and the missing rows are declared.
